title: Recover paired devices promptly after network changes and prevent stale relay sessions from disrupting active work.
changes: Probe relay WebSocket liveness from the client every 15 seconds and close silent half-open sessions before the operating system's TCP timeout.
Limit stalled opening handshakes to 12 seconds; retry transient proxy and captive-portal responses without overriding device revocation or workspace-disable controls.
Reject duplicate concurrent client connections and ignore obsolete socket events after a new session replaces an unsuccessful handshake.
Bound the agent's outbound WebSocket buffer to prevent uncontrolled memory growth on broken network links while retaining support for legitimate large runtime responses.

Verify reconnect, stale-close safety, duplicate connection prevention, timeout recovery, revocation and PostgreSQL-backed pairing in isolated regression tests; no new runtime permissions or MCP tools.
